policies.title: Israel, North Macedonia and Mexico ordinary passports: 30-day visa-free visit
policies.summary: The live MFA eVisa selector directly returns Visa free regime, up to 30 days, in the Ordinary Passport column for Israel, Macedonia and Mexico.
conditions: Direct selector replay used the page's country IDs 109 (Israel), 131 (Macedonia, mapped to North Macedonia/MK), and 143 (Mexico), then POSTed each doc_issued_by value to getVisaTypeInfo in the same PHP session.

Each returned ordinary-passport value is Visa free regime up to 30 days. No electronic, border-issued, diplomatic, service, residence, work, transit, security, carrier, or individual-admission route is inferred.
The response is session-bound and mutable; recheck the live official selector before travel. The portal labels MK as Macedonia rather than North Macedonia.
